name: GenAI-Bench-527
description: A community-contributed collection of 527 prompts designed to evaluate generative AI models across a range of short-form tasks (knowledge, reasoning, QA and generation). The set is intended for quick benchmarking of general capabilities of LLMs with a mix of multiple-choice and open-ended items.
reputation: A small, community-contributed benchmark with limited adoption compared to major public leaderboards.
